reply.text:
That one is a question for your prescriber or an endocrinologist who works with trans patients. How hormone therapy affects you is medical, and I'm not the right person to say what it will do to your training. I'd rather you hear it from someone who knows your labs and your regimen.

What I can do is the training side. I can build around your schedule, adjust volume and recovery as you tell me how sessions are feeling, and track your lifts so we can see what is happening in your numbers over time. If you want, tell me how many days a week you can train and what you're aiming for, and I'll set up a program.
